task.title: Set up a personal Cloudflare account for testing
task.description:
## Why
The first deploys go to a personal account. The free Workers plan cannot run a report: it allows 10 ms of CPU and 50 outbound calls per request, and an uncached league needs a couple of hundred Sleeper calls.

## Steps
1. Create or sign in to a personal Cloudflare account.
2. Subscribe to the Workers Paid plan. It raises the limits to 10,000 outbound calls per request and up to 5 minutes of CPU.
3. Note the account id from the dashboard.
4. Create an API token from the "Edit Cloudflare Workers" template, scoped to this one account. Check it also covers D1 and Queues, and add those permissions if not.
5. Store the token and account id in a password manager. Do not commit either.

## Done when
- `npx wrangler whoami` shows the personal account when run with the token.
- The account is on the Workers Paid plan.
